title: Information-Geometric Matter and a Constrained Gravitational Response
content: We turn oscillator-state distinguishability into a specified two-field matter action and develop a separate passive construction of an acceleration-dependent gravitational response. The Bogoliubov-Kubo-Mori metric of mixedness and fixed-axis squeezing, together with a chosen symmetric relative-entropy potential, fixes linked interactions and an invariant repulsive branch, and admits a controlled dust-like limit for occupied configurations. A constant area-entropy law with physical heat/area matching yields the Einstein equation under an explicit local-equilibrium closure. Convex duality realizes uniformly convex gradient costs with bounded Hessians as passive material responses with positive-energy dynamics on a prescribed background. A positive finite-support spectrum gives an AQUAL-like example tested against baryon-only GR. Across all 175 SPARC galaxies, three shared response coordinates reduce the RMS velocity residual on 761 retrospective outer points from 47.87 to 11.59~km/s, to within observational uncertainty. The inner RMS falls from 33.69 to 12.18~km/s. DC14 supplies a secondary halo benchmark. This calibration tests radial force performance; the response's microscopic source and metric completion remain open. Shell-detector results additionally motivate a conditional route to approximately Planckian occupations, a density-temperature scale with calibrated transition timing, and physical clock/propagation interpretations of redshift and apparent expansion. A separately prepared coherent two-field CMB benchmark has close internal agreement with a CDM control, although native convergence validation remains incomplete. The stored unfiltered Solar quadrupole at the distinct six-galaxy calibration is incompatible with the quoted Cassini control if its boundary solution is confirmed. A common conserving realization of the matter, constitutive and cosmological constructions remains open.
